display.purpose: Storefront proposition and major catalog headings.

label.purpose: Availability, navigation metadata, and short product labels.

motion.name: optical-study
motion.purpose: One authored transformation of the abstract optical study when a category is selected.

narrative.overview:
ISK Lenses pairs the live reference site’s cyan-blue product banners with a cool-white catalog that keeps real lens photography legible and color-accurate. Deep blue carries navigation and primary actions; sky blue owns selected page fields and image framing. Outfit headlines and an italic serif accent preserve the existing brand voice, while product names, prices, options, and availability remain factual and easy to scan. The admin workspace inherits the palette while retaining familiar, task-first operations.

Product images are never tinted. Abstract lens artwork is a graphic device, never product evidence. Real product media, prices, availability, and lens parameters appear only when operators add and verify them.
keyCharacteristics: Cool sky-blue fields and high-contrast deep-blue actions
True-to-source lens photography framed by pale blue surfaces
Factual product details remain clear and easy to scan
Admin forms and tables keep familiar task-first controls

rules.name: The Clear-Sky Field Rule
rules.body: Use broad sky-blue surfaces to give the storefront a coherent atmosphere; reserve deep blue for legible actions and navigation.

rules.name: The True-Color Photo Rule
rules.body: Keep product photographs and lens shades unfiltered; use blue in their framing, never as a tint over the product.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Use tonal fields and borders for structure; reserve inset light for the abstract optical study.

dos: Do keep product claims and specifications tied to fields actually present in the catalog.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and clearly named actions.
Do distinguish abstract illustration from real product media.
Do keep admin controls familiar and operationally clear.
donts: Do not tint source product photography or imply a lens color that the photo does not show.
Do not use unverified source details as published product claims.
Do not imply the in-page bag can submit an order.
Do not use the optical study as evidence of a real product color or specification.

components.name: Primary Action
components.css: .ds-button-primary { background: #006f9b; color: #fff; padding: 16px 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font: 700 14px/1.4 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #005b81; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #087ba5; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Search the live catalog by product name or category.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #cfe2eb; padding: 10px 12px; color: #15384d; font: 14px/1.4 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input { min-width: 8rem; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #15384d; font: inherit; outline: 0; } .ds-search:focus-within { outline: 2px solid #087ba5; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Selected Filter
components.css: .ds-filter { background: #006f9b; color: #fff; padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font: 700 12px/1.4 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-filter:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #087ba5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Admin Work Surface
components.description: Groups operational product and customer work.
components.css: .ds-admin-panel { background: #fff; color: #15384d; border: 1px solid #cfe2eb; border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; font: 14px/1.5 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-admin-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-admin-panel p { margin: 0; color: #526b7b; }

components.name: Optical Study
components.description: Abstract catalog illustration that is explicitly not product photography.
components.css: .ds-optical-study { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 260px; overflow: hidden; background: #15384d; } .ds-ring { width: 68%; aspect-ratio: 1; border: 1px solid rgba(184,232,245,.72); border-radius: 50%; } .ds-center { position: absolute; width: 34%; aspect-ratio: 1; border: 12px solid rgba(247,252,255,.88); border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #087ba5, 0 0 0 13px rgba(184,232,245,.78), inset 10px 6px 24px rgba(255,255,255,.38); }

narrative.overview:
The storefront treats each published listing as a specimen with inspectable facts, not a beauty promise. A cool, botanical paper field supports deep optical blue and a precise chartreuse signal; compressed display lettering and measurement-like labels make the catalog feel indexed. The admin workspace stays quieter and task-first, using white work surfaces, restrained borders, and familiar controls.

The abstract lens study is a graphic device, never product evidence. Real product media, prices, availability, and lens parameters appear only when operators add and verify them. The same truth-first rule governs empty states, option selectors, and the browse-only bag.
keyCharacteristics: Chromatic fields, not scattered accent decoration
Specimen-like product listings with factual metadata
Explicit separation between abstract illustration and real product media

rules.name: The Chromatic Field Rule
rules.body: Let large regions carry the palette; do not reduce chartreuse to a handful of unrelated badges.

rules.name: The Instrument-Scale Rule
rules.body: Use monospace for real catalog measurements or indexing; never as a generic “technical” costume.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Use tonal fields and borders for structure; reserve inset light for the abstract optical study.

dos: Do keep product claims and specifications tied to fields actually present in the catalog.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and clearly named actions.
Do distinguish abstract illustration from product photography.
Do keep admin controls familiar and operationally clear.
donts: Don't use unverified source details as published product claims.
Don't imply the in-page bag can submit an order.
Don't use the optical study as evidence of a real product color or specification.
Don't use chartreuse as body text on light surfaces.
